## Change and motivation

Describe the user-visible result, affected files or modules, and the acceptance criteria.

## Design and compatibility

Identify existing components reused or considered. Explain changes to public or wire contracts, MVC boundaries, dependencies, privacy and performance where relevant.

## Evidence

List the commands actually run, compiler and target, results, failure paths and any checks still pending. Explain inapplicable items from `docs/engineering/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md` at the revision under review.

## Review

Record self-review, independent findings and their disposition, remaining risks, and any justified policy exceptions.
